## How it was tested

- [ ] `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` pass
- [ ] Verified against a running `docker compose up` stack (not just a
      successful build) if this touches runtime behavior

## Checklist

- [ ] Scoped to one change (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md))
- [ ] No explanatory comments added (see CONTRIBUTING.md's code style
      note) unless covering a genuinely non-obvious *why*
- [ ] If this touches something PLAN.md documents, PLAN.md is updated
      to match
